name: fix-farming-hotbox
about: Fix (farming): hotboxing in town. A puff outdoors in town left no haze (Joint.as SpawnHaze returned early when nothing held the smoke); now it hotboxes the square: four haze banks around the smoker (radius 70), logged `haze: 4 bank(s) at x,y (town outdoors, radius 70)` and counted alive in `hwp joint`, and the strain's buff lands as before. The joint comes from farm.debug's `hwp farm herb` + `hwp joint roll`. Shot: hotbox (the player in the town square with the haze around them).

steps.pattern: \[HWP:farming\] self-check done: 8 seeds, 3 herb buffs, 30 joint items
steps.name: the module loaded with every joint item (both hands)
